findings.evidenceJa: 空は薄墨に染まっていた
findings.governingReading: The sky is dyed the pale gray-black of diluted ink.
findings.explanation: Thin is not a color and removes the ink-wash atmosphere.

findings.highlight: a battle she once went through
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女が駆け抜けた戦場
findings.governingReading: This is one of the battlefields across which she once raced.
findings.explanation: Battle replaces battlefield and went through loses the mounted speed and spatial traversal.

findings.evidenceJa: 今は従える騎兵もない
findings.governingReading: Now she has no cavalry under her command.
findings.explanation: Alongside removes the relation of command and obedience.

findings.highlight: becoming a feudal lord like her father
findings.evidenceJa: 父に代わって領主となった
findings.governingReading: She became lord in her father’s place.
findings.explanation: Like her father changes succession and substitution into resemblance.

findings.governingReading: The surface text names a cavalry formation while the ruby specifies Cataphract.
findings.explanation: Cavalry keeps only a generic concept and loses the formation-plus-specialized-name layering.

findings.highlight: had to defeat all her enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 全ての敵を切り捨てねばならなかった
findings.governingReading: Once she went to war, she had to cut down and discard every enemy.
findings.explanation: Defeat softens the repeated lethal “cut away” relation that mirrors her sacrifice of subjects.

findings.evidenceJa: 幾つもの部族を乱れなく統率し
findings.governingReading: The king brings several tribes under orderly command.
findings.explanation: The people erases the multiplicity and tribal political units being governed.

findings.highlight: the fair king honored by her knights isolated herself.
findings.evidenceJa: 王は、そうして孤立していった
findings.governingReading: The admired king grows increasingly isolated as others withdraw and distrust her.
findings.explanation: Isolated herself assigns the social outcome to her deliberate agency.

findings.governingReading: The king treats abandonment, fear, and betrayal as unavoidable matters beyond remedy.
findings.explanation: No right or wrong mistakes the idiom for a moral judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: みんなまだ寝てるんだろ
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers that everyone else is probably still asleep.
findings.explanation: Should sleep changes an inference about their present state into a recommendation.

findings.governingReading: They continued improvised, makeshift training because a superior common enemy targeted them.
findings.explanation: The English removes the provisional quality and turns the shared continued practice into Shirou training alone.
